name: Metaball Mercury
recipe: Organic metaballs: several charge points define a scalar field; the iso-contour surface merges and splits into liquid-mercury / lava-lamp blobs that flow, kiss and separate with smooth necking. Continuously drifting centers on K.t. Default COLORFUL: iso-bands through an iq palette (chrome-teal core -> magenta rim) with a bright surface highlight, or gooey lava. Luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: coarse per-pixel buffer (<=200 wide): sum_i r_i^2/((x-cx_i)^2+(y-cy_i)^2) over ~7 drifting charges; threshold near iso=1 for the surface, band the field for colour, add a rim/highlight. Charges orbit on K.t; cache nothing per-pixel (recompute each frame).
style: mercury (default, chrome-teal->magenta iso-bands + highlight). Also: lava-lamp (orange/red gooey on dark), x-ray (glowing iso-lines), oil-chrome (iridescent), ink (named mono, black blobs on cream).

name: Clifford Attractor
recipe: Clifford strange attractor: x'=sin(a y)+c cos(a x), y'=sin(b x)+d cos(b y) iterated ~40-80k points accumulating into a silky filamentary cloud with delicate moire striations. Slowly drift a,b,c,d on K.t so the whole form morphs and breathes continuously. Default COLORFUL: density -> log-scaled through an iq palette (indigo low -> gold high) glowing on dark, luminance ~0.12-0.35.
kernel: accumulate into a coarse density buffer in S each frame (or persistent with slow fade): iterate the Clifford map ~40k steps from a fixed start, splat each point into the density grid; map log(1+density) through a palette LUT, upscale. Drift coefficients on K.t (small) so the attractor perpetually reshapes.
style: silk (default, indigo->gold density on dark). Also: plasma (magenta/cyan), ember (blackbody density), bioluminescent (teal/green), pencil (named mono, graphite on cream).

name: Plasma Globe
recipe: Tesla plasma-globe: several branching electric filaments arc from a central electrode outward, jittering and forking like dielectric-breakdown lightning, occasionally re-striking to new positions — crackling energy. A soft central glow + faint outer sphere. Default COLORFUL: electric violet/cyan bolts with white-hot cores on near-black, luminance ~0.12-0.35 (bright bolts on dark).
kernel: each frame draw ~5-9 branching polylines from center: recursively fork with random angle jitter (seeded per-strike, re-struck on K.t/beat), two-pass glow (wide dim ADD + thin bright core). Filaments wander continuously on K.t so they never freeze; central radial glow gradient.
style: violet-arc (default, violet/cyan bolts, white cores). Also: crimson-tesla (red/orange), neon-green (toxic green), ice (pale blue), blueprint (named mono, white bolts on blue).

name: Rising Smoke
recipe: A buoyant turbulent smoke column rises and billows: warm smoke particles born at the base accelerate upward, curl through noise turbulence and disperse into soft plumes and vortices. Continuous emission so the column is always alive. Default COLORFUL: incense/ember smoke (amber base -> grey-violet dispersal) OR colored vapor; on a dark ground. Luminance ~0.15-0.4.
kernel: particle array in S (<=1800): emit at base with upward velocity + buoyancy, advect by curl-noise(pos, K.t) + rising bias, fade/grow with age, recycle dead ones; draw as soft ADD blobs into a slow-fade buffer, hue by age/height. K.t evolves turbulence.
style: incense (default, amber->grey-violet). Also: colored-vapor (cyan/magenta plumes), volcanic (red/black ash), ghost (pale white on black), pencil-smoke (named mono, graphite).

name: Double Pendulum Chaos
recipe: A fan of many double-pendulums released from nearly-identical angles diverges into chaos, their bob-tips tracing luminous curling ribbons that start together then scatter — a vivid demonstration of sensitive dependence. Trails fade so the frame stays legible; re-release on K.section. Default COLORFUL: each pendulum's trail hue by its index (spectral fan) glowing on dark, luminance ~0.12-0.35.
kernel: array of ~40-120 double-pendulum states in S (theta1,theta2,omega...) integrated with RK4/semi-implicit each frame (real gravity); draw each bob-tip into a slow-fade trail buffer, hue by index. Re-seed the fan (tight angle spread) on K.section so divergence replays. Motion is intrinsic.
style: spectral-fan (default, index-hue trails on dark). Also: firefly (warm tips), neon (cyan/magenta), blueprint (white arcs on blue), ink (named mono, black trails on cream).

name: Feedback Tunnel
recipe: Video-feedback tunnel: the previous frame is scaled/rotated slightly and re-drawn under a fresh injected shape, creating an infinite recursive zoom tunnel of echoing kaleidoscopic trails — the classic camera-into-monitor psychedelia. Default COLORFUL: injected hue rotates on K.t so the tunnel walls cycle spectrum; bright echoes spiraling inward/outward. Luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: persistent buffer in S: each frame draw the buffer back into itself transformed (translate to center, scale ~0.96-1.04, rotate small angle, all drifting on K.t) at slightly reduced alpha, then inject a fresh bright motif (polygon/ring/burst) whose hue rotates on K.t; the recursion creates the tunnel. Guard against wash-out (fade) and freeze (continuous transform).
style: spectral-vortex (default, hue-cycling tunnel). Also: neon-kaleido (mirrored), infrared (thermal echoes), mono-strobe (named mono, high-contrast), oil-slick (iridescent).

name: Koch / Dragon Fractal
recipe: An L-system fractal curve (Koch snowflake / dragon curve / Levy C) unfolds and refolds: the polyline subdivides to deeper iterations and morphs between fractal families as an interpolation parameter sweeps on K.t, the whole figure slowly rotating and breathing. Default COLORFUL: the curve stroked with a hue gradient along its length glowing on dark, filled faintly. Luminance ~0.18-0.45, fills frame.
kernel: generate the fractal vertex list to depth D (cache per seed/depth/family), interpolate vertex positions between two fractal families by a K.t-swept t, draw as a hue-gradient polyline (+ soft glow) rotating slowly on K.t. Rebuild cache on depth/family change.
style: spectral-curve (default, hue-along-length on dark). Also: gold-leaf (metallic on black), neon (glow), blueprint (white on blue), ink (named mono, brush on cream).

name: Hex Cellular Automaton
recipe: A cellular automaton on a HEXAGONAL lattice: 6-neighbor totalistic rules (or hex cyclic-CA) breed rotating snowflake-symmetry growth, spreading crystalline six-fold patterns and spiral fronts across the frame — distinct from square-grid CAs. Default COLORFUL: cell states/age through a vivid ramp, honeycomb cells visible, luminance ~0.2-0.5, edge-to-edge.
kernel: hex grid stored in an offset-coordinate array in S (<=140 wide); each frame apply a 6-neighbor totalistic/cyclic rule; render hexagons (or a per-pixel hex-nearest LUT) colored by state/age. Seed from center/noise, reseed to keep it growing. K.t gates steps.
style: crystal (default, six-fold age ramp). Also: honeycomb (amber/gold cells), ice (blue/white snowflake), toxic (green/black), etched (named mono, hex outlines).

name: Diffusion-Limited Aggregation
recipe: FIX of a weak version: the crystal was TINY in a mostly-empty dark frame, near-static (motion 0.006), with a visible spawn-CIRCLE artifact. Re-author so the DLA dendrite GROWS FAST and BIG, filling most of the frame within a few seconds, then resets and regrows (perpetual visible growth). Release MANY walkers per frame (hundreds) so accretion is rapid; grow from multiple seeds or a central seed until the crystal spans ~70% of the frame; NEVER draw the spawn radius circle. Recolor branches by age so the fractal reads. Default COLORFUL: age gradient (violet core -> cyan -> white frost tips) on near-black, luminance ~0.15-0.4, and the growing frontier gives strong continuous motion.
kernel: occupancy grid + point list in S; each frame release hundreds of walkers near the current frontier, random-walk (a few steps each, with a bias toward the aggregate to speed sticking) until adjacent to occupied then freeze; draw newly-frozen cells with age-colored glow into a PERSISTENT buffer (no per-frame clear). When the aggregate radius exceeds ~0.7*frame or on K.section, fade out and reseed. NO visible spawn circle.
style: frost (default, violet->cyan->white age gradient). Also: copper-electro (metallic dendrite), gold-leaf (gold branches, black), neon-coral (magenta/teal), graphite (named mono, pencil on paper).
